name: mobilegym_scroll_regression
description: Scroll overshoot regression at medium and deep list positions.

tasks.prompt: 在“列表实验室”的长列表中，必要时向下滚动，找到第 24 项（标题为“取回蓝色雨伞”），打开它的详情页。不要使用搜索。
tasks.description_for_judge: Open Scroll Lab item 24 of 100, titled 取回蓝色雨伞, with preview 周四下班前去前台领取，报登记尾号 7312。 and record code SL-024. Scrolling past it and back still counts as an overshoot.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Scroll Lab detail page for item 24 / 100, code SL-024.

tasks.prompt: 在“列表实验室”的长列表中，必要时向下滚动，找到第 83 项（标题为“冷链样品交接”），打开它的详情页。不要使用搜索。
tasks.description_for_judge: Open Scroll Lab item 83 of 100, titled 冷链样品交接, with preview 到北门 3 号柜领取银色保温箱，核验码 K4M7。 and record code SL-083. Scrolling past it and back still counts as an overshoot.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Scroll Lab detail page for item 83 / 100, code SL-083.
